name: Guns GirlZ F.M. RepliCant
source:
This is the Guns Girl Z: Fire Moth story recreated in the RepliCant engine.
That means you can read the whole Guns GirlZ: Fire Moth story on your own using this software, since the game is no longer available in English.
translation:
本作是使用RepliCant引擎重制的《崩坏学园2：逐火之蛾》剧情阅读器。
鉴于原版游戏已不再提供英文版本，你可以借助本软件独立阅读《崩坏学园2：逐火之蛾》的完整故事。
